json.notes: Oval white-clad arena with a layered roof: a tall inner drum and a lower white ring terrace around it. The front (south, -z) has a tall curved glazed facade under a big sweeping white canopy overhang, with a brick base and silver spheres on the plaza. I model the oval shell as stacked ovals (bowl parts), the inner roof drum, the glass front wedge with its overhang, the brick base and the spheres.
